hip-37279.x: Icy M-class moon orbiting a ringed gas giant in the Procyon (Alpha Canis Minoris) system; homeworld of the Andorians and founding Federation member.
Lush UNSC tourism and resort colony in the Procyon system besieged during Halo Wars (2531).

trappist-1-b.x: Innermost rocky world of the ultra-compact TRAPPIST-1 resonant chain, receiving four times more stellar flux than Earth and confirmed by JWST MIRI to lack a thick atmosphere.
